blocks.text: Klook Philippines celebrated the standout champions of local tourism at the annual Klook Partner Awards on October 6, honoring its top-performing partners. The awards recognized excellence across Klook’s three primary travel pillars—Play, Stay, and Move—with specialized categories highlighting each partner’s unique contributions to driving Philippine tourism. “We wanted to honor our partners who have raised the bar for Philippine tourism and consistently ensure exceptional experiences to travelers across Luzon, Visayas, and Mindanao,” said Michelle Ho, General Manager of Klook Philippines. “Klook remains deeply committed to investing in the Philippines.
